question:
**Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.**

A ground where the last funeral rites are performed
solution:
The correct answer is "**Crematorium.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The word 'Crematorium' means a place where dead bodies are burned to ashes.**(श्मशान)
 
• It is used for performing the last rites of a deceased person by burning their body.
 
 
• Example: There’s a crematorium next to the graveyard.
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the word "crematorium" can substitute the given phrase.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2 (Tomb) refers to a place where a dead body is buried, usually with a gravestone or monument erected on top.(मकबरा)
 
• Option 3 (Mortuary) refers to a place where dead bodies are stored before they are buried or cremated.(शवगृह)
 
• Option 4 (Barracks) refers to a building or group of buildings used to house soldiers or military personnel. (सेनावास)
